Audit ETLook Mass Balance Conservation

Source: R/analysis_indicators.R
wapor_audit_etlook_mass_balance.Rd

Verifies that actual evapotranspiration and interception (AETI) equals the sum of its constituent components: soil evaporation (E), crop transpiration (T), and rainfall interception (I), such that AETI = E + T + I within a given tolerance.

Usage

wapor_audit_etlook_mass_balance(aeti, e, t, i, tolerance = 1e-04)

Arguments

aeti

SpatRaster or numeric. Actual evapotranspiration and interception.

e

SpatRaster or numeric. Soil evaporation.

t

SpatRaster or numeric. Canopy transpiration.

i

SpatRaster or numeric. Canopy interception.

tolerance

Numeric. Maximum allowable absolute discrepancy (default 1e-4).

Value

A list containing:

is_conserved

Logical indicating whether the mass balance is satisfied within tolerance everywhere.

max_absolute_error

Maximum absolute error observed.

mean_absolute_error

Mean absolute error observed.

discrepancy

Numeric or SpatRaster of residual discrepancies (AETI - (E + T + I)).

References

Bastiaanssen, W. G. M., Menenti, M., Feddes, R. A., & Holtslag, A. A. M. (1998). A remote sensing surface energy balance algorithm for land (SEBAL).

  1. Formulation. Journal of Hydrology, 212-213, 198-212.

Examples

wapor_audit_etlook_mass_balance(aeti = 100, e = 30, t = 65, i = 5)
#> $is_conserved
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $max_absolute_error
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $mean_absolute_error
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $discrepancy
#> [1] 0
#>
